repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-user
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for user identity. It registers webex.internal.user, which resolves emails and user objects to uuids through a debounced batcher and an in-memory id and email store, and wraps the identity, atlas, conversation, and SCIM calls for account verification, activation, one-time passwords, password and name updates, preferred meeting site updates, and meeting site list building.

modules.coverage_evidence: Field coverage 93.3% (14/15) assessed 2026-10-27 by the generator; critical field coverage 8/8. The one WEAK field is test strategy: test/unit/spec/user.js covers the SCIM helpers, argument guards, recordUUID, updatePreferredWebexSite, and getMeetingSiteList, and test/unit/spec/user-uuid-batcher.js covers only the creator batcher, but account-flow request shapes, the create guard, fetchUUID, the faker batcher, the store, getUserCI, the config defaults, and persistence have no unit case, test:integration is undefined, and no characterization baseline exists. Held at Partial: no spec-drift record exists and a characterization baseline is required before risky modification.

user-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package imports the device plugin and registers User as internal plugin 'user' with the config object from src/config.js. The entry point re-exports User as the default export. The methods, the hasPassword property, and the config.user defaults are summarised in src/docs/README.md.

user-identity-http.summary: Outbound HTTP calls to the conversation service (batched POST /users with shouldCreateUsers on the creator path, GET users, PATCH users/user), the atlas service (POST users/activations), the credentials activation, OTP, and set-password URLs, and the identity SCIM endpoint (PATCH identity/scim/<org>/v1/Users/<user>). No route is served by this package.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; no module spec, so source was used: registerInternalPlugin, WebexPlugin, Batcher, persist, waitForValue, request, config, credentials)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Supplies the plugin host, the Batcher base, request and config access, persisted state, and webex.credentials (getUserToken, getClientToken, getOrgId, set).

webex-device-registration.source: @webex/internal-plugin-device (workspace package; module spec consulted: webex.internal.device userId and url)
webex-device-registration.summary: webex.internal.device.userId is read by _setUser and updatePreferredWebexSite. src/index.js imports the device plugin before registering user.

webex-common-sdk.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: patterns, oneFlight, tap, deprecated, Defer)
webex-common-sdk.summary: Shared patterns for uuid and email checks, the oneFlight de-duplication decorator, tap, and the deprecated decorator.
